text:
maya: Quick sweep after the onboarding run — found a few broken links in /runbooks/onboarding.md (esp the 'env setup' section). Anyone owns that runbook? @sam? :eyes:

alex: I can take a look, ping me the exact URLs.

maya: thanks! here's the list I hit: https://redwood.example/runbooks/onboarding.md#env-setup, https://redwood.example/runbooks/kv-cache, and the screenshot https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-assets/screenshots/setup.png returns 404.

sam: I actually noticed one of these earlier — suspect fallout from the shortlink migration we ran Tue night. Adding to my queue.

docs-bot: [link-scan] 4 dead links detected in /runbooks/onboarding.md — ticket created DOCS-987.

alex: Cool. Could we add a tiny smoke check in docs CI that curls the main runbook and fails on non-200? Minimal and helpful.

maya: +1. Example we could add to the workflow:
```
curl -fsS https://redwood.example/runbooks/onboarding.md || exit 1
```

jess: Small owner note — if sam is taking it, can you update the frontmatter owner or CODEOWNERS so future scans auto-assign?

sam: Yep. Plan: (1) rehost the missing screenshot to our imgs CDN, (2) fix the dead relative link to kv-cache, (3) update frontmatter owner: "sam", (4) add the curl smoke check. I'll open a PR and link it here. ETA EOD.

maya: Awesome — ping if you want a quick pairing session on the rehost step. :thumbsup:

alex: I'll review the PR once it's up. :eyes:

docs-bot: patch created: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/pull/1234 (assigned to sam).

maya: Closing the loop — I've marked the board card as "in progress" and will move to "done" after PR merge. Thanks everyone!
